questions.qtext:
Select the related word from the given alternatives.
Finicky: Unfastidious : : Intimidate : ?
questions.solution:
Finicky means extremely picky, or hard to please whereas Unfastidious means not meticulous,
careless, or easy to please. Thus,
‘Finicky’ and ‘unfastidious’ are antonyms.
Similarly, the antonym of ‘Intimidate’ (to frighten, threaten) is ‘console’ (to comfort, soothe).
Hence, 'console' is the correct answer.

questions.qtext:
Examine the following statements:
1. Sourabh scored more than Neetu.
2. Neetu scored less than Rakhi.
3. Rakhi scored more than Sourabh.
4. Renu scored more than Sourabh but less than Rakhi.
Which of the following options is/are correct?
questions.solution:
I : Sourabh > Neetu
II : Rakhi > Neetu
III : Rakhi > Sourabh
IV : Rakhi > Renu > Sourabh
From the above relations, we get Rakhi > Renu > Sourabh > Neetu
Thus, Rakhi scored the highest and Neetu scored the lowest.

options.text: Reciprocity theorem is inapplicable to circuits with time varying elements.
Reciprocity theorem is inapplicable to circuits with dependent sources.
Reciprocity theorem is inapplicable to unilateral networks.
Reciprocity theorem is inapplicable to circuits with transformers.

questions.solution: Reciprocity theorem is applicable to the network comprising of linear, time invariant, bilateral, passive elements such as ordinary resistors, inductors, capacitors and transformers.

questions.qtext:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?
1. Lag compensator decreases the band width.
2. PI controller reduces the peak overshoot.
3. PID controller is similar to lag-lead compensator.
4. PD controller reduces SNR ratio.
questions.solution:
• Lag compensator increases the rise time so it decreases the Bandwidth.
• PI increases the damping ratio (ξ) and reduces the peak overshoot (Mp).
• P-I-D controller is similar to lag lead compensator or
• PD controller amplifies noise and hence reduces SNR ratio.
